name: BPJSType2DiabetesCardiorenalPhenotype
title: Computable Phenotype for T2DM Cardiorenal Progression in BPJS Single-Payer Claims
description: Standardized computable phenotype resolving administrative Z-code masking in Indonesian national health insurance claims (2015-2024), extracting presenting clinical conditions from admission ICD-10 and secondary diagnosis registries.

characteristic.description: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus confirmed via admission code FKL16 or secondary registry sec_diag
Exclusion of pure administrative follow-up episodes lacking secondary or admission clinical confirmation
Cardiorenal Comorbidity: Hypertensive heart/kidney disease (I10-I13) or Chronic Kidney Disease (N18)
